text.p: These settings, and all pages in the tree, apply to the currently active project. Changes take effect when you click OK or Apply.
Trace Directory lets you specify where your traces are stored, in case the default location is not preferred. By default this is empty, meaning the default location is used.

Percepio Tracealyzer also offer settings for trace streaming. In case very large files are recorded, you can choose to open the Trace Preview that lets you load a smaller section of the trace.
The lower threshold (ask if exceeding) decides when Trace Preview is suggested.
The higher threshold (always use if exceeding) decides when Trace Preview is opened automatically.
text.note: This is based on estimated host memory usage, not the size of the trace file.
